I remember only this much about my dream. 1509 views Q. - DREAM - I had this dream long ago. I have 4 brothers and 1 sister. I dreamnt that we were living in a lone house, in the middle of a desert. Our car was parked some way away from the house. One night (in the dream) I went to the car and started the ignition. But instead of going forward the car raised up into the air. It kept rising up and reached a most beatiful place with abundant greenry, trees and breathtaking scenery. The grass was of a very rich colour and I remember a stream flowing some way away. I have not seen a place so beautiful in my lifetime. I heard my brothers calling from down below .. they said that "Mum is calling you" .. but I was so immersed in the beauty of the place that I refused to go back down. The scene changed: I was down again. It was another night and I went to the car again. I started the ignition again. The car rose but but was stopped 5-6 feet into the air.. My brothers had tied a rope to the back of the car and now they started pulling me back. i remember insisting on going up but they brought me down. I was really sad. I kept thinking about the place. On the 7th day after I had gone to the beautiful place, I looked at the moon and found a face on it. I was about 8-10 years old when I saw this dream. Now I'm almost 19. answer: Miscellaneous >> Others Question ID: 37956 Country: India Title: muraqaba Question: I offer salat 5 times a day but unable to concentrate in it. And so not unable to concentrate on my job also. Even when I am sleeping in night, some bad dreams (negative dreams) are coming. I read on internet that doing muraqba increases concentration, is it true. Please explain doing muraqba is allowed in islam or not? If it is allowed then what is the process? Answer ID: 37956 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 650/558/B=1433) Keep on reciting istighfar and durood very often. Also, pray five times salah. Being punctual in offering salah will help you concentrate on job. You need not do muraqabah. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
